justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/modifier/Ownership.java and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/description/modifier/OwnershipTest.java. Ownership is a compact enum with only 2 constants (MEMBER, STATIC), 1 field, and 4 simple methods (getMask, getRange, isDefault, isStatic) over 79 lines; it has one narrow responsibility of mapping field/method/type ownership to ASM modifier masks. The test covers just this single concern, and there is no evidence of multiple separable responsibilities or excessive size/behavior.
